baseline_models.focus_anchor: دُعُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ ... سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا
baseline_models.mechanism: A spoken summons draws disputants into an entrusted forum; adjudication addresses the interval between them, hearing completes as compliance, and falah names the durable outcome of letting that circuit close.

activation_trace.role: Calling and inclining by speech initiates movement toward the adjudicative forum.
The messenger and carried message identify the entrusted channel to which the summons directs them.
Judgment between people supplies the forum's concrete work of deciding the dispute.
The middle or interval between parties locates the dispute and the ruling's relational field.
Hearing as understanding and implementation makes reception an operative stage rather than bare acoustics.
Compliance carries the received ruling into conduct and closes the response circuit.
Winning, survival, and attainment name the lasting result of completed response.

changed_reading.before: The ayah commends generic obedience after an address.
changed_reading.after: It defines belief as closing a concrete adjudicative circuit: answer the summons, receive the ruling, and enact it so dispute can reach durable success.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَوْلَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ... أَن يَقُولُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا
baseline_models.mechanism: The doubled saying does more than prescribe words: the first qawl identifies the believers' characteristic response, while the second is authenticated by the coupled acts of understanding and compliance.

activation_trace.role: A thing's 'saying' as its indication lets the voiced formula function as a diagnostic sign of identity.
Heart-settling assent supplies the inward identity that the response must visibly indicate.
Understanding that tends toward implementation prevents 'we heard' from remaining a verbal claim.
Actual compliance is the behavioral verification of the believers' saying.

changed_reading.before: The defining response is a prescribed phrase.
changed_reading.after: The phrase is a testable sign of believing identity: 'we heard' becomes true as a social claim only in the ensuing compliance.

baseline_models.mechanism: Judgment can restrain damaging conduct for reform, work within the connection between the parties, and cut an opening through deadlock; success is therefore relational repair as well as a favorable result.

activation_trace.role: Restraint and return for reform cast judgment as stopping the damage that sustains conflict.
The connection standing between parties makes their relation, not only their rival claims, an object of repair.
Cutting or opening supplies the image of making a passage through an otherwise closed dispute.

changed_reading.before: Judgment merely selects a winner between two sides.
changed_reading.after: Judgment can also restrain the damage and reopen the relation between sides; accepting that corrective opening is itself part of flourishing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first trains hearing under evidentiary discipline: testimony must speak from knowledge, while heard accusation must be stopped rather than passed mouth to mouth. The focus response therefore follows an authorized adjudication, not an indiscriminate readiness to obey whatever is heard.

activation_trace.role: Testimony as declaration from knowledge supplies an evidentiary gate before a damaging claim is accepted.
Auditory reception supplies the earlier test case in which merely hearing an allegation does not authorize relaying it.
Emitted speech supplies the harmful relay that disciplined hearing must refuse to reproduce.
Knowledge as disclosure is explicitly absent, exposing the relay as speech detached from known reality.
Understanding that governs response turns the second hearing scene into a model of ethical refusal.
In the focus, understanding and implementation now receive the outcome of a legitimate judgment.
Adjudication between people is the institutional filter that distinguishes this hearing from rumor uptake.

structural_cues: 24:4 and 24:13 require witnesses before punitive accusation is accepted.
24:12-16 twice stage hearing an accusation and prescribe speech that stops, rather than circulates, unsupported claims.
24:51 places hearing after summons to adjudication, not inside the rumor chain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contrasted hearing-speech sequences and witness requirements; I infer that authorized adjudication filters what is heard before obedience. A live alternative is that 24:51 stresses readiness alone without commenting on procedure.

changed_reading.before: 'We heard' means unqualified receptivity to whatever reaches the ear.
changed_reading.after: 'We heard' is disciplined uptake of an adjudicated claim: believers refuse unsupported speech, yet enact a determination reached through an authorized forum.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence contrasts professed obedience followed by withdrawal, refusal of the same summons, eager submission only when one's right is secured, fear of judicial bias, and strenuous oaths. Against those failures, the focus saying is a precommitment whose truth appears when the outcome is uncertain or adverse.

activation_trace.role: Turning the back supplies the behavioral contradiction to the preceding profession of belief and obedience.
Presenting one's side and turning away supplies the concrete refusal of the identical adjudicative summons.
A right specifically possessed by its owner marks the favorable condition under which selective respondents eagerly attend.
Submission and compliance become a self-interest control because they appear when the right belongs to the respondents.
Deviation in judgment names the feared possibility that tests whether trust survives an uncertain outcome.
A solemnly apportioned oath supplies the surplus verbal assurance that the sequence refuses to treat as proof.
Intended action supplies the observable criterion placed over strenuous swearing.
Saying as indication makes the focus formula evidential only insofar as conduct bears it out.
Actual compliance verifies the saying precisely where selective submission would fail.

structural_cues: 24:47 places 'we believe and obey' immediately before a faction turns away.
24:48 repeats the focus summons, while 24:49 makes attendance conditional on the right being theirs.
24:53 rejects strenuous oaths as a substitute for recognizable obedience and known deeds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies professions, withdrawal, favorable-case submission, fear of bias, oaths, and deeds; I infer a counterfactual test of accepting an unknown or adverse ruling. A live alternative is that the contrast concerns hypocrisy generally rather than adverse outcomes specifically.

changed_reading.before: The formula reports compliance once a congenial ruling is known.
changed_reading.after: The formula is a precommitment to impartial judgment: its truth is exposed when the ruling may frustrate one's own claim, and conduct rather than oath authenticates it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated clarification, illumination, and guidance activate a second value of the focus's بَيْنَهُمْ: the adjudicative interval is not merely where a verdict lands but where obscured facts and relations become legible enough for informed response.

activation_trace.role: Manifest and disclosed signs establish clarification as the surah's opening epistemic action.
Uncovering meaning through word or sign makes clarification an ongoing communicative process.
Light and illumination supply the surah's central image for making what guides action visible.
Clear signs immediately before the dispute sequence reactivate disclosure beside the focus's locative 'between.'
Gentle direction toward path and truth gives clarification a practical destination rather than leaving it as display.
The interval between parties is the concrete location into which the disclosure model is activated.
Knowledge that hits the right judgment supplies the epistemic quality needed to clarify the interval.

structural_cues: The surah opens with clear signs and repeatedly returns to God clarifying signs.
The light passage at 24:35 makes visibility a mechanism of guidance.
24:46 places clear signs and a straight path immediately before the speech-and-judgment sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated ب ي ن clarification branches, light, guidance, and the focus's locative بَيْنَهُمْ; I activate disclosure inside that interval. The primary live alternative is that بَيْنَهُمْ remains strictly locative and contributes no epistemic overtone.

changed_reading.before: 'Judge between them' only means issue a decision among parties.
changed_reading.after: It can also mean opening the disputed interval to clarity, making facts and relations legible enough that hearing may become responsible compliance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across homes, private times, and collective affairs, movement across a boundary is regulated by permission and responsive return. The summons into adjudication becomes another social threshold: believers neither invade on unilateral desire nor evade under cover, but enter the shared process when called and yield control to its ruling.

activation_trace.role: Entering an interior supplies the basic threshold crossing that the surah subjects to authorization.
Permission and licensing make another party's authorization, not the mover's desire, govern entry.
Returning when told supplies a compact earlier example of hearing a boundary and enacting it.
Repeated permission governs departure from a shared affair and extends threshold ethics into collective action.
Slipping out supplies the unauthorized exit that reverses open responsiveness to the messenger's call.
Hiding behind another supplies the covert social mechanism by which accountability is evaded.
The call inclines disputants across the threshold into a shared adjudicative process.
Entrusting judgment transfers unilateral control of the dispute to an authorized decider.
Compliance accepts the forum's boundary on self-directed action after entry.

structural_cues: 24:27-28 prohibit entry without authorization and require immediate return when return is spoken.
24:58-59 repeat permission rules at vulnerable private times.
24:62-63 govern leaving a collective affair and expose covert slipping away from the messenger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated authorized entry and exit scenes plus the focus summons; I infer a shared threshold mechanism across private, collective, and judicial domains. A live alternative is that the privacy rules remain domain-specific and do not color adjudication.

changed_reading.before: The ayah concerns courtroom obedience in isolation.
changed_reading.after: It participates in a surah-wide ethics of authorized movement: do not cross social boundaries by unilateral desire, and when called into judgment, surrender the dispute to shared rule.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fear that the judge may deviate blocks the immediate respondents, while the later promise joins belief, empowerment, and the replacement of fear with security. The focus's المؤمنين and accepted judgment can therefore be read as a trust practice with a communal security horizon, not only a private virtue.

activation_trace.role: Anticipatory fear supplies the affect that makes parties suspect and avoid an uncertain judgment.
A promise that opens hope supplies the future communal horizon attached to belief and right action.
Empowerment supplies the institutional stability within which a shared rule can endure.
Expected harm supplies the prior condition explicitly replaced in the promise sequence.
Belief and security share the branch of heart-settling trust, linking the agents to the promised social condition.
The believers are named through security and trust at the point where they accept adjudication.
Shared judgment supplies the public practice through which trust is tested.
Durable success gives accepted judgment a horizon beyond winning the present case.

structural_cues: 24:50 names fear of judicial deviation as the final suspicion before the focus response.
24:55 juxtaposes those who believe with the replacement of fear by security.
24:51 calls the trust-responsive agents both believers and those who attain lasting success.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the fear-security contrast, shared ء م ن root, empowerment, and accepted judgment; I infer that repeated just response helps instantiate communal trust. A live alternative is that security is solely a divine grant and no causal institutional link is intended.

changed_reading.before: 'Believers' is an identity label and falah is individual success.
changed_reading.after: Accepting trusted judgment performs the security latent in belief and points toward a community where fear of one another's power is replaced by stable shared rule.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This meteorological-agricultural mechanism is surprising because it crosses domains and does not claim lexical equivalence. It remains anchored in the focus's relational بَيْنَهُمْ, reforming judgment, and agrarian فلاح, while 24:43 explicitly composes what is between clouds before rain emerges. Downstream prose should present it only as a controlled material analogy for conflict becoming cultivable.

activation_trace.role: Joining one thing to another supplies the compositional action that gathers separated elements.
Connection standing between elements supplies the relational medium in which cloud composition occurs.
Descending rain supplies the beneficial release that follows composition in the contextual sequence.
Restraint for reform anchors the analogy in judgment's capacity to alter a damaging relation.
The parties' existing connection is the focus-level relational medium on which judgment works.
The cultivator who splits soil turns successful respondents into an agrarian image of reopened possibility.

changed_reading.before: The successful are simply those who receive a favorable legal outcome.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they resemble cultivators: they let reforming judgment work in the connection between parties and reopen conflict into ground where communal benefit can take root.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates material and locomotion branches rather than the ordinary legal senses. It remains anchored in the focus's bridle branch of حكم, easy gait of رسول, and enacted طاعة, and the context repeatedly contrasts straight path, turning away, and covert exit. Downstream prose should qualify it as a movement analogy, not a claim that the ayah literally describes riding.

activation_trace.role: The straight road supplies the directed course announced immediately before the judgment sequence.
Turning the back supplies the overt wrong-way movement contrasted with the focus response.
Slipping out supplies the covert trajectory by which a person evades shared accountability.
The bridle that checks an animal supplies a material image for judgment restraining self-serving momentum.
Easy, supple gait supplies the responsive motion made possible once the course is accepted.
Compliance and tractability turn auditory assent into a redirected, governed trajectory.

changed_reading.before: Hearing and obeying are static assent.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they are a redirected gait: judgment reins in self-serving motion and places the respondent on a straight, publicly accountable course rather than permitting withdrawal or covert exit.

strongest_changes: The surah's accusation sequence makes 'we heard' evidence-filtered reception rather than credulity.
The immediate contrast makes 'we obeyed' a precommitment tested by an uncertain or adverse ruling, with deeds outranking professions and oaths.
Repeated clarification activates judgment as making the disputed interval legible, while permission scenes place it inside a wider ethics of authorized social movement.
The shared ء م ن field links accepted judgment to a communal horizon in which fear is replaced by security.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context converted a compact legal response into a diagnostic ecology of speech, evidence, boundaries, movement, and trust without detaching any retained model from summons, judgment, hearing, obedience, or falah in 24:51.
remaining_uncertainties: The adverse-outcome test is strongly suggested by 24:49 but may be one instance of a broader hypocrisy contrast.
The clarification sense of ب ي ن is an activation across repeated forms; the locative sense remains syntactically primary in بَيْنَهُمْ.
The institutional path from individual obedience to communal security is reader-supplied and may exceed the direct causal claim of 24:55.
The cloud-field and reined-trajectory models should remain analogical outliers, not lexical replacements.
